The selected tables, adapted descriptions and their translations are provided
under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Source copyright policy: https://splatoonwiki.org/wiki/Inkipedia:Copyrights

Changes by Salmon Review contributors (2026): selected Salmonid HP, Salmon Run
weapon statistics and common timing columns, rank/IDV and quota tables;
omitted PvP columns and unrelated sections; reformatted data for offline use;
translated and condensed explanations into Chinese and Japanese; added search.
Reference-data.js and adapted table explanations retain CC BY-SA 4.0.
Application code retains its separate AGPL-3.0-or-later license.
Game names retain the rights of Nintendo and other original rights holders.
No image or font binaries are bundled. The application downloads the source
page's game icons from Inkipedia on first view and caches them locally. These
images have separate rights, not the table text's CC BY-SA license. See each
file page linked below for its provenance and rights statement; Nintendo game
artwork remains the property of Nintendo. Remote loading does not grant an
additional license. No affiliation or endorsement is implied.

Some source values are unknown (N/A, ?) or internally inconsistent. These are
preserved unless an explicit correction is recorded below. Roller DPS order
is horizontal/vertical.
Snipewriter DPS labels distinguish the charge-and-burst cycle, burst alone,
and uncharged taps. This is a dated community reference, not a
live game-parameter feed.

Dynamo Roller correction (2026-11-01):
The Inkipedia snapshot listed 184.6/138.5 DPS and 65/85 frames. Cross-checks:
https://wikiwiki.jp/splatoon3mix/サーモンラン/ブキ別立ち回り/ローラー属
  Horizontal: 200 damage, 66 frames, 181.8 DPS.
  Vertical: 300 damage, 85 frames, 211.8 DPS.
https://overfishing.wiki/ウェポン情報
  Same damage/intervals, rounded DPS 182/212.
The displayed data uses 66/85 frames and locally calculated DPS:
  horizontal = 200 * 60 / 66 = 181.818...;
  vertical = 300 * 60 / 85 = 211.764... .
Rounded to one decimal: 181.8/211.8. This is maximum continuous-flick DPS,
not DPS including ink refill time. Only these factual numeric values were
cross-checked; no prose, images or page templates from these two sites were copied.
